events.text: Goal! Real Madrid 1, RB Leipzig 0. Bernardo Silva (Real Madrid) left footed shot from very close range to the centre of the goal.
Goal! Real Madrid 2, RB Leipzig 0. Arda Güler (Real Madrid) left footed shot from very close range to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Kylian Mbappé.
Substitution, RB Leipzig. Rocco Reitz replaces Neil El Aynaoui.
Substitution, RB Leipzig. Andrija Maksimovic replaces Brajan Gruda.
Álvaro Carreras (Real Madrid) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Rocco Reitz (RB Leipzig) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Real Madrid. Yan Diomande replaces Vinícius Júnior.
Substitution, Real Madrid. Marc Cucurella replaces Álvaro Carreras.
Substitution, RB Leipzig. Max Finkgräfe replaces David Raum.
Substitution, RB Leipzig. Tidiam Gomis replaces Antonio Nusa.
Substitution, RB Leipzig. Christoph Baumgartner replaces Christopher Nkunku.
Substitution, Real Madrid. Brahim Díaz replaces Arda Güler.
Goal! Real Madrid 3, RB Leipzig 0. Kylian Mbappé (Real Madrid) right footed shot from the left side of the box to the top right corner. Assisted by Yan Diomande.
Goal! Real Madrid 3, RB Leipzig 1. Tidiam Gomis (RB Leipzig) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Christoph Baumgartner.
Goal! Real Madrid 4, RB Leipzig 1. Yan Diomande (Real Madrid) right footed shot from the left side of the box to the top left corner. Assisted by Brahim Díaz.
Substitution, Real Madrid. Carlos Espí replaces Kylian Mbappé.
Substitution, Real Madrid. Endrick replaces Jude Bellingham.
